input.subject: Conservatory back door lock – Flat 22, 148 Lantern Quay (ref R/PM021-1)
input.body:
Hello,

Re: Flat 22, 148 Lantern Quay, Westmarsh, ZZ4 1ZZ – ref R/PM021-1

Thank you for reporting the snapped key for the conservatory back door. Your landlord has agreed for the lock to be replaced and new keys provided, and we are now arranging a locksmith. We will confirm the appointment with you once it is booked.

So we can prioritise this correctly, please could you reply to let us know: is the back door currently locked shut and secure, or is it unlocked / unable to be locked? If the door cannot be secured, please let us know straight away. In the meantime please don't force the lock or try to remove the broken piece of key, and keep the door closed and any other doors secured.

It would also help to know your availability for a locksmith visit.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings
